families.armed_now: {name} waa firfircoon. Shaqooyinka la mid ah ee halkaas si toos ah ayaa loo eryi doonaa.
families.body: Marka aad diiddo laba shaqo oo isku nuuc ah oo ka socda hal shaqo-bixiye, Dawnlist wuxuu ku soo jeedinayaa xeer: joojiso howshaas shaqo-bixiyahaas, laakiin sii akhri kuwa kale. Wax lama firfircooneeyo ilaa aad taas u ogolaato, oo soo jeedin kastaaba wuxuu tusayaa diidmooyinka uu ka dhashay.
families.heading: Shaqo-bixiyayaasha aad diiday
families.none: Weli wax lama soo jeedin. Kuwan waxay soo muuqan doonaan marka aad diiddo laba shaqo oo isku mid ah oo ka socda isku shaqo-bixiye.
families.none_found: Wax cusub oo la soo jeedin karo ma jiraan.
families.stood_down: {name} waa la damiyay. Wax kale halkaas kama eryayo hadda.
onboarding.aim_placeholder: Hal ama laba jumlo, si aad ku qorto qaabkaaga. Nooca shaqada aad rabto, heerka ku dhow, meesha, inay tahay shaqo joogto ah ama qandaraas, iyo ugu yaraan mushaharka aad diyaar u tahay inaad ka hadasho. Wax kasta oo aad ka tagto, Dawnlist waa inuu qiyaaso.
onboarding.brief_label: Warbixinta ku habboonaanta — waxa la soo bandhigo
onboarding.calibration_body: Waa kuwan toban dalab oo firfircoon, iyo waxa Dawnlist ka gorfeeyay mid kasta. Sax wixii uu qaldamay. Meesha aad ku khilaafsan tahay, u sheeg jumlada haddii lagu daro warqadaada gaaban ay saxi lahayd — jumladaas ayaa gelaysa warqadaada gaaban, si khaladkaas aan berri dib loogu soo celin.
onboarding.disagreement: Ma raacsanid — Dawnlist waxay tidhi {app}, adiguna waxaad tidhi {user}.
onboarding.draft_failed: Lama diyaarin karin CV-yadaada: {reason}. Waxaad qofkeenu ku qori kartaa labada dukumeenti oo aad sii socoto.
onboarding.drafted: Waa la diyaariyay. Sax wax kasta oo qalad ah ka hor inta aadan sii socon.
onboarding.drop_hint: Halkan ku soo tuur faylalka CV-gaaga — PDF, Word ama qoraal caadi ah
onboarding.factsheet_label: Xaqiiqda asalka — waxa la sheegi karo
onboarding.finish: Dhammayso oo bilow socodka maalinlaha ah
onboarding.interview_body: Dawnlist wuxuu akhriyay CV-yadaada oo diyaariyay laba dukumeenti. Saxee — waa bilow, mana aha go'aan kama dambays ah. Xaqiiqda dhinaca bidix ah waa waxa kaliya ee wixii soo saarista shaqadaadu (outreach) ay ku sheegi karto ku saabsan adiga. Warbixinta ku habboon ee dhinaca midig ayaa go'aamisa waxa la soo bandhigo subax kasta.
onboarding.low_signal: Waxaad ku raacday wax kasta, taasoo caadi ahaan macnaheedu yahay tijaabadan inay fudud tahay, ee maaha in warqadda gaabani dhammaystiran tahay.
onboarding.open_questions: Dawnlist ma garanin, oo wuxuu ka tagay su'aalahan furan:
onboarding.ready: Diyaar — warqadaada gaaban waxaa lagu cusboonaysiin doonaa waxa aad bartay.
onboarding.sentence_placeholder: Jumlada la geliyo warqadaada gaaban, ee tan sax lahaa waa maxay?
onboarding.title: Dawnlist — habaynta
rules.body: Ka hor inta aan wax lagu akhrin qaab-nooleeye, Dawnlist wuxuu ku kalifayaa shuruudahan. Shaqo halkan lagu joojiyo wax kama qaadato; shaqo soo gudubta waxay qaadataa qayb yar oo sentigii ah inta la akhriyo. Ku bilow iyada oo aan la lahayn — ku dar shuruud markaad ogaato inaad isla go'aan mar labaad qaadanayso.
rules.conflict: Lama darin — waxay noqon lahayd mid qariya jagada aad raacday:
rules.contextual: Akhri haddii uu ku jiro cinwaanka
rules.contextual_help: Ereyo cinwaan shaqo ku macno leh laakiin faqrad faa'iidooyinka ku macno la'aan. Waxaa lagu barbardhigayaa cinwaanka iyo shirkadda oo keliya.
rules.employers_help: La kasbaday, lama qorin. Raacida jago waxay ku darsaa shaqo-bixiyahan halkan, oo shaqo kasta oo dambe oo ka timaada ayaa la akhriyaa. Haddii go'aanka la beddelo, mar kale wuu ka bixi.
rules.heading: Shuruudaha kaliyaha
rules.strong_help: Calaamad meel kasta — cinwaanka, shirkadda ama sharraxaadda. Shaqo la mid ah mid ka mid ah kuwan waxaa mar walba loo diraa in la qiimeeyo.
rules.unsupported_help: Ereyo cinwaan ah oo ka reeba shaqo si kastoo shaqo-bixiyuhu wanaagsan yahay. Waxaa la hubiyaa marka hore, iyo iyadoo lagu barbardhigayo dhammaan jagooyinka aad raacday ka hor inta aan la aqbalin.
settings.code_redeemed: Xeerka waa la aqbalay — shatigaaga waa la kaydiyay.
settings.key_body: Dawnlist wuxuu akhriyaa dhaqdhaqaaqyada shaqada oo qoraa fariimahaaga isagoo isticmaalaya moodelada Anthropic, iyadoo lagu shaqaynayo akoonkaaga gaarka ah. Samee furaha console.anthropic.com kadibna ku dhex qor halkan. Waad ka baabi'in kartaa wakhti kasta, Dawnlist-na wuxuu ku kaydiyaa maareeyaha xogta aqoonsiga ee nidaamkaaga hawlgalka — marnaba fayl kuma kaydiyo.
settings.key_forgotten: Furaha waa la saaray. Dawnlist ma shaqayn karto ilaa aad ku darto mid kale.
settings.key_none: Weli ma jiro furaha la kaydiyay — Dawnlist ma shaqayn karo iyada la'aanteed.
settings.licence_body: Ku dhex qor furaha shatiga ee ku yimid emailkaaga iibsiga. Haddii lagu siiyay xeer sokeeye (override code) halkii shati, sidaas ku dhex qor — Dawnlist ayaa ku badali doona shati.
settings.licence_none: Weli ma jiro shati la kaydiyay.
settings.title: Dawnlist — dejinta
voice.no_profile: Wali ma jiro qaab-cod — ku dar qaar ka mid ah iimayladaada la diray
